contract: Lumen full visual-system redesign rendered in a local browser preview; screenshots show the actual shared CSS applied to representative task, navigation, toolbar, calendar and state surfaces.

accessibility.evidence: At 390x844, keyboard Tab navigation visibly focused the Sync action with a two-pixel mint focus ring. Buttons retain names, selected navigation uses shape and text as well as color, and primary mobile targets are 48px high. Reduced-motion, reduced-transparency and high-contrast CSS preferences are present; Windows assistive-technology combinations were not device-tested.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at 1440x900, 1024x768 and 390x844. The desktop toolbar stays in one row, the tablet groups controls, and the phone switches to a touch layout with bottom navigation; document width matched viewport width at all three sizes.

loading.evidence: states-dark.png shows a readable loading skeleton with a heading and text rows.

empty.evidence: states-dark.png shows a titled empty state with an actionable create button.

error.evidence: states-dark.png shows an error explanation and a retry action without crushing the text.

partial.evidence: states-dark.png shows partial evidence as a distinct warning card while preserving readable content.

success.evidence: states-dark.png shows saved status and the resulting record together.

permission.reason: The preview contains no browser permission flow. File selection is delegated to the operating system and no new runtime permission was added.

renderedEvidence.observation: Dark desktop: title, single-row action toolbar, date strip, task cards and navigation hierarchy.
Light desktop: same hierarchy with paper-gray surfaces, readable text and mint emphasis.
Tablet width: controls wrap as groups without horizontal overflow.
Dark phone layout with touch-sized actions, one-line dates and bottom navigation.
Light phone layout with the same content hierarchy and touch navigation.
Phone keyboard navigation with a visible focus ring on the Sync action.
Loading, empty, error, partial and success examples under the shared dark theme.
